header.name: Linear Optimiztion
header.description: This course aims at introducing students to the application of linear and optimization techniques. We will primarily focus on linear optimization (linear programming) and learn about the structural and algorithmic aspects of optimization problems. The theoretical assignments will aim at developing the necessary skills for analysing algorithms and formulation of LPs. Computational assignments will complement the theory by modeling real-world problems as linear programs and solve them using publicly available solvers. Towards the end of the course, we will briefly discuss integer linear programs, and semi-definite programs (SDPs) with real-world applications and point to some of the existing solvers for this class of problems.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Should be able to formulate Linear optimisation problems in the standard mathematical form and solve them using solvers.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Be able to define dual linear programs and obtain duals of given linear programs.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Evaluate different formulations of linear programs and solve them using different algorithms for linear programming such as simplex, interior point methods and the ellipsoid algorithm.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Model problems using variants and extensions of linear programs such as integer linear programs and semi-definite programs.
